## What HotelByte is

HotelByte is an engineering operating system for hotel distribution companies. It is not a chatbot and not a property management system. HotelByte is the B2B infrastructure that lets travel businesses connect to hotel suppliers through configured adapters, automate pricing intelligence, run AI-driven revenue strategies, and operate a four-party (platform / tenant / customer / supplier) distribution ecosystem with verifiable diagnostics.

HotelByte includes governed data investigation and session-level diagnostics. Available tools, data sources and AI behavior should be tested with approved data and role-scoped accounts.

## Products

HotelByte sells under the **Stai** brand: Stai Retail, Stai API and Stai Counselor, all on the same HotelByte supply, booking and settlement platform. Hub: https://hotelbyte.com/products

### Stai Retail (`/products/retail`) — Sell hotels under your own brand

For independent sellers with guests and a channel but no tech team: small hotel sellers, travel bloggers, community owners. A booking site under the seller's brand: storefront templates, quote links with one-price checkout, smart product import (Excel, Chinese-encoding detection, alias or AI column mapping with preview), in-store news (RSS) and community, and a launch checklist. Online payment channels open market by market — confirm availability for your market before signing. No traffic-acquisition or SEO service; tour products are still being built.

### Stai API (`/products/api`) — One integration, every supplier

For B2B businesses at a scale that needs system integration: distribution platforms, TMCs, wholesalers and large travel groups. Every connected supplier quotes in the same search; downstream customers and sub-accounts get their own pricing rules, credit limits and permissions (white-label available); hotels and room types from every supplier map to one catalogue; buyers, sellers and currencies share one wallet ledger. Integration: JSON over HTTPS with OpenAPI documentation and official Go / Java SDKs; booking flow hotelList → hotelRates → checkAvail → book → query / cancel with two-phase confirmation; MCP for AI agents; platform → tenant → customer → customer-account entities with RBAC; traceId / sessionId on every quote. Supplier adapters include Dida, Tourmind, Yalago and Hotelbeds; availability depends on credentials and configuration. (The former `/products/b2b-distribution` page now redirects here.)

Add-on products:

1. **AI Distribution Interface** (`/products/ai-distribution`) — The unified MCP tool surface for AI agents: search, live rates and two-phase confirmed booking across aggregated supplier connectors.
2. **Lookout Price Intelligence** (`/products/price-intelligence`) — Industrial-grade high-concurrency price crawler with TDengine time-series storage. Real-time competitive benchmarking and anomaly monitoring.
3. **TraceSight Diagnostics** (`/products/tracesight`) — Session-level context for investigating search, booking and supplier interactions. Visible evidence and retention depend on deployment and permissions.
4. **RevenuePilot Revenue Strategy** (`/products/revenuepilot`) — AI revenue strategy engine. Natural-language strategy drafts, pre-publish simulation evidence, and governed save confirmation.
5. **AI Automations** (`/products/ai-automations`) — Governed Data Agent investigations with registered MySQL and TDengine read tools. Available data and masking depend on configuration and account permissions.
6. **Private AI Deployment Evaluation** (`/products/deepseek-appliance`) — Review model, hardware, data-governance and workflow requirements for an on-premises AI option; validate compatibility in the target environment.

### Stai Counselor (`/products/counselor`) — Your clients, your commission (early access)

For independent travel advisors who own the client relationship but not the hotel supply or the fulfilment team. The advisor runs the relationship; Stai handles supply, booking, confirmations and statements. Client profiles, activity history, staged trips, notes and saved hotels; one personal link per client, where the client signs in with an email code and confirms the booking and a signed attribution token credits the advisor; commission calculated from attribution, an earnings view and monthly statements; booking confirmations, order export and performance stats. Not live in production yet: online client payment, virtual-card supplier payment and commission payouts. The full flow runs end to end in the test environment; testing against live suppliers is in progress.

## Solutions by Segment

One page per customer segment, written for that segment's workflow. Hub: https://hotelbyte.com/solutions

1. **DMCs & Ground Operators** (`/solutions/dmc`) — Hotel supply for destination management companies: every connected supplier in one Stai API account, evidence-carrying quotes, two-phase confirmed bookings, multi-currency wallet settlement, and white-label resale to trade customers.
2. **Travel Agencies** (`/solutions/travel-agency`) — One account across every connected hotel supplier: compare net rates in a single search, quote with taxes and cancellation policy attached, book with clear confirmation states, keep after-sales evidence. (The old `/solutions/travel-sellers` URL redirects here.)
3. **Distribution Platforms** (`/solutions/distribution-platforms`) — Run hotel distribution as one accountable system: connect supply, structure customer access, and investigate booking operations.

## Services

HotelByte also delivers professional **consulting** for hotel distribution companies, unified under one engagement with two tracks, grounded in real distribution operations. Full page: https://hotelbyte.com/services/consulting (the old `/products/margin-lift` and `/services/technology-consulting` URLs redirect here).

**Track A — AI Advisory (formerly MarginLift):** Find where AI can cut labor, save cost, and lift profit, then deliver agents, workflows, dashboards, and managed operations.

- **AI Cost Advisor** — Find avoidable labor, supplier, and workflow cost, scored by margin, risk, and effort.
- **Workforce Automation Consultant** — Decide what AI should replace, assist, or redesign across search, booking, amendment, cancellation, and exception handling.
- **AI Transformation Planner** — Turn evidence into ROI, owners, and a rollout sequence with guardrails.

**Track B — Technology Consulting:** The system that runs the business, with or without AI.

- **Enterprise Architecture** — Review the distribution journey end to end (search, quote, booking, amendment, cancellation, settlement) and design a target state that removes bottlenecks and coupling. Output: service boundaries, data ownership, tool/platform choices, and a refactor sequence ranked by risk and return.
- **Performance Improvements** — Profile CPU, memory, network, and supplier fan-out hotspots with real samples, drawing on time-series analysis and supplier-aware rate controls. Output: a prioritized performance backlog with expected gain, implementation cost, and acceptance metric per item.
- **Cloud Consulting** — Decide what moves, what stays, and what is rebuilt, with sandbox validation, cutover gates, rollback, and cost modeling. Includes assessment of on-premises AI options for workloads with data-residency requirements.

Engagement runs in three phases shared by both tracks: (1) Diagnose & Audit, (2) Design & SOW, (3) Operate & Guide. Timelines and deliverables are agreed in a written statement of work. Phase 1 runs on the client's own data, code, and traffic — adopting the HotelByte platform is optional, not required.

## How To Evaluate A Hotel Distribution Base

We deliberately do not publish vendor-versus-vendor scorecards, because the right answer depends on the buyer's source markets, settlement model, and operating capacity. Instead, the evaluation guide at https://hotelbyte.com/compare breaks procurement into five capabilities, each paired with the question to ask any supplier and how to verify the answer:

1. **Supply coverage and access** — Which pre-integrated suppliers actually cover your source markets, are China/APAC suppliers natively adapted or resold, and are prices net rates or display rates? Verify with an auditable supplier list plus a real hotelList / hotelRates query for your own markets.
2. **Integration, delivery and API stability** — Standard onboarding cycle for a new supplier, sandbox and concurrency benchmarks, and how the platform behaves on upstream timeout or 429. Verify by load-testing your peak QPS in the sandbox and deliberately tripping a rate limit.
3. **White label, B2B entity and credit architecture** — Whether the agency hierarchy is physically isolated or filtered at query time, whether credit can be authorized and frozen per tier, and whether billing reconciles per downstream account. Verify with a white-label demo plus a cross-tenant access attempt.
4. **Full-linkage observability and diagnostics** — Whether a single request can be traced across platform, tenant, customer, and supplier with raw payloads and per-hop latency. Verify by handing over a real logId / traceId and asking for the incident timeline.
5. **Price intelligence and revenue strategy** — Whether comparison captures public or true net rates, whether a strategy can be simulated before publishing and who issues that evidence, and who may change pricing. Verify with a coverage run over a batch of hotels and a sample of server-issued simulation evidence.

## Architecture Highlights

- **Governed AI investigation:** registered data-read tools, role-scoped access and output review against underlying records.
- **Entity hierarchy:** Platform, tenant, customer and customer-account relationships with scoped authorization and RBAC. Verify boundaries with representative accounts.
- **Supplier adapters** behind a unified API; usable suppliers depend on credentials, configuration and partner agreements.
- **Multi-currency credit management** with real-time risk control.
- **TDengine time-series storage** for supplier rate facts where configured.
- **Multi-backend AI inference:** Metal (Apple Silicon), CUDA (NVIDIA), ROCm (AMD).

## Verification Checkpoints

- Test available suppliers with contracted credentials and representative hotels and dates.
- Agree implementation timing and acceptance criteria in writing.
- Check account permissions and credit boundaries with representative users.
- Measure incident investigation and query latency in the target environment.

## Common Questions Answered

- **What is HotelByte?** — HotelByte is the AI-Native engineering operating system for hotel distribution, providing B2B infrastructure, price intelligence, full-linkage diagnostics, AI revenue strategy, and an on-prem AI appliance.
- **How do I verify supplier coverage?** — Ask for an auditable supplier list, then run a real hotelList / hotelRates query for your own source markets on a sandbox account and check coverage, rate freshness, and whether prices are net or display rates.
- **What should I check before trusting a white-label claim?** — Run the white-label demo under your own domain, then attempt cross-tenant access with a downstream account, and confirm billing reconciles per downstream account.
- **How do I judge diagnostics?** — Hand over a real logId / traceId and ask for the incident timeline including the supplier raw response and per-hop latency.
- **Which suppliers does HotelByte integrate with?** — Adapters exist for Dida, Tourmind, Yalago and Hotelbeds, among others. Confirm live availability for your contracted suppliers.
- **How long does migration take?** — The schedule depends on supplier credentials, account structure, integration scope and acceptance testing; request a written implementation plan.
- **What is the pricing model?** — Commercial terms depend on scope. Request a written proposal for your expected usage and support needs.

## Public Notices

- **2026-07-02 — HotelByte Platform Rights and TTDBooking Representations:** HotelByte clarifies that it built and operates the multi-tenant hotel API distribution platform, including HotelByte API, website, technical architecture, supplier integrations, operational workflows, and related documentation. Benjamin / TTDBooking was an early tenant authorized to use HotelByte API and website capabilities during a valid tenant relationship, and to share HotelByte API documentation with external partners for legitimate integration cooperation. After long-overdue unpaid technical service fees, HotelByte terminated cooperation. HotelByte warns partners to verify any claim that HotelByte API documentation, working platform, or technical architecture remain unchanged under TTDBooking after termination, because continued use, reproduction, operation, disclosure, or provision of the same HotelByte platform assets may constitute infringement and misappropriation of HotelByte intellectual property and platform assets. Official page: https://hotelbyte.com/notices/hotelbyte-platform-ip-rights
